title: Biblical Friendship
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Biblical friendship is faithful companionship that strengthens faith, speaks truth, bears burdens, and points others toward God. True friendship is more than shared interests; it is love practiced with wisdom, loyalty, honesty, and grace.
summary: Biblical friendship is faithful companionship that strengthens faith, speaks truth, bears burdens, and points others toward God. True friendship is more than shared interests; it is love practiced with wisdom, loyalty, honesty, and grace.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the truest Friend, laying down His life for His people and bringing them near. His love teaches believers how to pursue friendship with sacrifice, truth, humility, and faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture honors faithful friendship. A friend loves at all times, speaks needed truth, sharpens character, and stands near in trouble.

Biblical friendship is not flattery. Faithful wounds from a friend may be painful, but they can be a gift when spoken with love and wisdom.

Friendship also involves presence. Ecclesiastes teaches that two are better than one because they help one another when one falls. God often strengthens His people through faithful companions.

Jesus gives friendship its highest pattern. He laid down His life and called His disciples friends, showing love that is sacrificial, truthful, and rooted in obedience to God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people have many contacts but few faithful friends. This doctrine reminds believers that friendship is a serious means of encouragement, correction, joy, and perseverance.

It also calls believers to become the kind of friends they desire: truthful, loyal, prayerful, humble, and Christ-centered.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pursue friendships that help you walk with God. Be honest, loyal, prayerful, and willing to speak truth in love. Do not settle for shallow connection when God calls His people to relationships that sharpen faith and strengthen endurance.
